name: bug_academybugs_currency_freeze_01
description: Website freezes when changing currency on a product detail page.

nodes.content: Navigate to the 'Find Bugs' page by opening the URL: https://academybugs.com/find-bugs/

metadata.expected_result: The 'Find Bugs' page (https://academybugs.com/find-bugs/) is loaded and displayed.

nodes.content: Identify the first product displayed on the 'Find Bugs' page (e.g., 'DNK Yellow Shoes') and click its link to navigate to the product detail page.

ui_elements: First product link on the page
metadata.expected_result: The product detail page for the selected product is loaded and displayed.

nodes.content: On the product detail page, locate the dropdown menu used for currency selection and click it to reveal the currency options.

metadata.expected_result: The currency selection dropdown menu expands, showing available currency options.

nodes.content: From the expanded currency dropdown menu, click on a currency option that is different from the one currently active (e.g., if 'USD' is active, select 'EUR' or 'GBP').

ui_elements: Currency option in dropdown (e.g., EUR, GBP)
metadata.expected_result: The website becomes unresponsive or freezes.

verification_steps: After attempting to change the currency as described in step 4 of the task graph (clicking a different currency in the dropdown on the product detail page), observe the application.
Confirm that the website interface has become unresponsive or frozen, preventing further interaction.
missing_information: Screenshots of the 'Find Bugs' page, product detail page, and currency dropdown for visual reference.
Specific UI element locators (e.g., CSS selectors, XPaths) for the product links, currency dropdown, and currency options, which would be necessary for precise automation.
